title: How to Build an Intelligence Requirements Framework for Fast-Moving Crises
excerpt: Learn how to build a compact intelligence requirements framework for fast-moving crises by starting with decisions, assigning owners, using GIR/PIR/SIR structure, prioritizing collection, and adding review, access, and sharing rules.
